description:
End-to-end validation that the new flow works in the now-canonical
single-repo state, with all old tooling deleted and all docs aligned.
This is the first release where there is no fallback - the old
automate_release.py is gone, and the retired private clone is no
longer a viable working copy.

If anything is still missing or broken in the new flow, this is where
it surfaces. Fixes are quick because the surface area is small (a
Makefile target, one workflow file, one changelog generator).

Run from ~/Developer/benchbox-public (the new dev locus).

Plan file: /Users/joe/.claude/plans/single-repo-migration.md (Phase 8).

anti_patterns.dont: release a marketing or major-feature version here unless it was already planned
anti_patterns.why: this release is a process validation, not a product event; keep the user-facing change small.

anti_patterns.dont: resurrect deleted scripts as a "just in case" workaround
anti_patterns.why: the entire point of the migration was to delete them; if the new flow has a gap, fix the gap, do not regrow the old surface.
release.yml going green proves the workflow ran, not that the wheel is functional; only a fresh pip install does.

preserves.behavior: All previously published versions on PyPI remain installable; this release is purely additive.
The new release flow is the ONLY release flow now. There is no fallback. If something breaks, fix it in the new flow.

verifications.command: uv run --isolated --with pip -- python -m pip index versions benchbox 2>&1 | head -1

verifications.description: Wheel installs and imports cleanly from PyPI
No remaining references to deleted modules anywhere in the repo

verifications.command: gh pr view <release-pr> --json body --jq '.body' | grep -c '## API surface diff'
verifications.description: Release PR includes the migration API surface diff gate

work_units.notes:
release-recovery-v0-3-1 cuts and verifies v0.3.1 as the first real
release on the new flow with no fallback — the exact exercise this phase
was created to perform. Before any release work here, make the call
explicit (record it in _project/decisions/single-repo-migration.md):
  - RETIRE: if the v0.3.1 recovery release already exercised the new flow
    end-to-end, move this TODO to DONE as "satisfied by v0.3.1" and skip
    w1-w7.
  - SEPARATE: if a distinct later validation release is still wanted,
    proceed to w1-w7 using v0.3.2+ (v0.3.1 is consumed by recovery).
Mirrors the decision required by release-recovery-v0-3-1 w7; do not leave
it implicit in the dependency graph.

DECISION 2026-07-09 (maintainer-approved): RETIRE — Phase 8 is satisfied
by the v0.3.1 recovery release. w1-w7 are deliberately skipped, not
forgotten.

Rationale: this phase exists to prove the new flow works end-to-end in the
canonical single-repo state with no fallback. v0.3.1 did precisely that —
`make release-cut VERSION=0.3.1` off `develop`, curation, squash-merge to
`main` (`7550c423d`), tag, and `release.yml` run 29055922350 publishing to
PyPI with green cross-platform install smoke — with `automate_release.py`
already deleted (Phase 6) and docs aligned (Phase 7). Phase 4 closed the
same day as recovery-complete. Cutting a v0.3.2 solely to re-run a passed
exercise would add a public release with no user-facing content.

The exercise did surface two real gaps, both recorded in
_project/decisions/single-repo-migration.md (2026-07-09 amendment):
`release-cut` did not perform the `-s ours` history alignment that a
`vX.Y.Z -> main` PR needs, and the `validate-base` bootstrap failed to
restore `auto_merge_soundness_paths`. Both are now fixed and
regression-tested — the alignment merge was folded into `release-cut`
itself (PR #1089), so a future cut no longer performs it by hand.
Recorded in _project/decisions/single-repo-migration.md, not left implicit.
work_units.summary: Decide: is Phase 8 satisfied by the v0.3.1 recovery release, or is a separate release needed?

Check the latest CI run is green: gh run list --branch main --limit 1
Confirm Phase 6 deletions and Phase 7 docs are merged to main.
work_units.summary: Confirm main is green and all migration phases are merged

work_units.notes:
git describe --tags --abbrev=0
v0.3.1 is consumed by release-recovery-v0-3-1, so the next version here is
v0.3.2 unless a new feature warrants a minor bump.
work_units.summary: Pick the next version (v0.3.2+, since v0.3.1 is the recovery release)

work_units.notes:
The release target now runs without any fallback. If it fails,
the failure is in the new flow itself - not because of stale old
code. Fix and retry.

By this point the changelog generator has been exercised at least
once (Phase 4). Output should be reasonable. Spend a few minutes
polishing the user-facing bullets.

The release PR body must include the API surface diff section from
`_project/specs/migration-api-surface-gate.md` before this work unit
can be marked done:
  - New CLI commands
  - New console_script entry points
  - New public Python imports
  - New file-system conventions
  - Approval / ADR link for any non-empty entry
work_units.summary: Review the release PR, edit changelog if needed, squash-merge
